description:
Paravirtualized drivers and guest agent for Windows guests running on the XCP-ng hypervisor.

XCP-ng Windows Guest Tools provides the paravirtualized device drivers and guest agent for Windows guests running on the XCP-ng hypervisor. The installer includes the Xen bus, interface, network, storage, console, keyboard/mouse, HID, and standard VGA display drivers, along with driver installation support, the XenPlus guest agent, and the XenClean and XenBootFix maintenance utilities.
This release brings important bug fixes to the Windows drivers and installer.
Important note for users upgrading from 9.2.350: You must first install the XenTools-fix-9.2.351.msp hotfix to upgrade to 9.2.351 before installing 9.2.445. Otherwise, upgrades from 9.2.350 will be blocked. Reboot is not required after installing the hotfix.
The installer downloads include a copy of XenClean and XenBootFix. It is not necessary to run XenClean when upgrading from previous versions of the XCP-ng Windows guest tools, unless prompted by the installer. Remember to carefully read XenClean docs before use.
Note: Always download the latest XenClean/XenBootFix from https://github.com/xcp-ng/win-pv-drivers/releases . You can find them in the latest release ZIP/ISO archives.
Before installing
Thank you for using our Windows PV tools. Please carefully read the instructions below.
- It is not necessary to run XenClean when upgrading from previous versions of the XCP-ng Windows guest tools, unless prompted by the installer.
- Not compatible with the "Manage Citrix PV drivers via Windows Update" option. You must disable this option before installing.
Changes since 9.2.385
- NEW: Group Policy support (see the extras/admx directory in the source code tree). Supported policies include:
  - Hide the tray icon
  - Disable all features that allow controlling the VM from the host
- Improved: Better network performance.
- Improved: System reliability improvements on driver upgrade failure.
  - On an upgrade failure, the installer will remove all Xen drivers to ensure that the system will keep operating, and to allow you to safely uninstall the existing driver package.
- Improved: Remove obsolete Windows Update devices and don't block installation because of them.
- Fixed: Fix further data corruption bugs during memory snapshots and backups.
  - This driver version significantly narrows the corruption window. However, fully fixing all known corruption issues requires further work in other XCP-ng components. Please keep an eye on the XCP-ng blog for updates.
- Fixed: Fix loss of VBD connection after storage migration.
- Fixed: Improve reliability of the clipboard service.
- Fixed: Improve reliability of the VIF IP configuration feature.
- Fixed: Reliability fixes on VMs with many vCPUs (>64).
- Fixed: Many other driver reliability fixes.
Help / Community support
If you encounter installation/uninstallation errors, please try again with one of the following commands:
For installing:
msiexec.exe /i XenTools-x64.msi /l*vx install.log

For uninstalling:
msiexec.exe /x XenTools-x64.msi /l*vx uninstall.log
Please include this log along with the file C:\Windows\INF\setupapi.dev.log in your bug report. These files will help us troubleshoot any installation issues.
Additionally, please report any errors or BSOD you encounter during testing of this release. Your feedback is very appreciated.
- Discussion: https://xcp-ng.org/forum (preferred)
- Issue Tracker: https://github.com/xcp-ng/xcp/issues
